## Description

Component : BD4TU
Databufffer with 3-state
Used in CGA (Sheet 5/10) page 6
In the drawings the read bufffer is connected to "PTREE1" for read-enable
Which is connected to 1/HIGH. Not really sure what thus migth mean.
